content: I was wondering whether the first note in the docstring of docs#IO.runRand (i.e. "stdGenRef is not necessarily properly seeded on program startup as of now and will therefore be deterministic.") is still up to date as, in l.124-126 of Random.lean, the initialization of stdGenRef uses IO.getRandomBytes.
This topic was moved here from #mathlib4 > Docstring of `IO.runRand` by Gaëtan Serré.
